nodes.label: Atelier architectural-film art direction
nodes.text: Full-screen fixed cinematic media with sticky editorial story panels, large negative space, warm dark scrims and an architectural walkthrough rhythm.

nodes.label: Atelier oversized serif editorial hierarchy
nodes.text: Oversized Cormorant Garamond serif display typography, tight tracking, DM Sans or Manrope support, tiny uppercase letterspaced metadata and sparse editorial labels.

nodes.label: Atelier ink stone ivory palette
nodes.text: Near-black ink ground with stone beige, warm ivory and restrained Mediterranean blue accents; warm natural material palette.

nodes.label: Atelier patient architectural camera grammar
nodes.text: Patient dolly, crane, threshold, interior arc, material macro and horizon-release camera moves controlled continuously by scroll with copy fades and focus pulls.

nodes.label: Atelier approach-to-horizon narrative
nodes.text: Approach, orientation, threshold, interior, material, ritual, process, horizon and inquiry chapters build toward one wide landscape release.

nodes.label: Atelier horizon release
nodes.text: After a compressed architectural walkthrough, the camera and composition release into the widest coastal horizon view before settling into private inquiry.

nodes.label: Atelier observational scroll interaction
nodes.text: The visitor primarily observes a scroll-directed architectural film with selective material hotspots and a horizontal image roll rather than constructing or configuring the experience.
